blocks.text: O'zbekchada «vaqtida keldim» deganda ikki xil narsani nazarda tutishimiz mumkin: 1) **reja bo'yicha**, kechikmasdan keldim; 2) biror narsaga **ulgurib** keldim, kech qolmadim. Ingliz tilida bular ikki xil ibora: **on time** va **in time**. Xuddi shunday «oxirida» ham ikkiga bo'linadi: **at the end** (biror narsaning oxirgi qismida) va **in the end** (oxir-oqibat). Bu iboralar 121-darsdagi vaqt predloglari mantig'iga tayanadi; qizil kitobda **on time** faqat bir ibora sifatida tilga olingan (→ qizil kitob, 111-dars). Bu darsda ularni juft-juft taqqoslaymiz.

rows: jadval yoki rejadagi aniq vaqtda, kechikmasdan
biror narsa boshlanishidan yoki kech bo'lishidan oldin

blocks.text: on time — reja bilan bir chiziqda

**on time** ishlatilishi uchun oldindan belgilangan vaqt — jadval, uchrashuv soati, muddat (deadline) bo'lishi kerak. Ibora shu vaqtga **aniq mos kelganini** bildiradi: na erta, na kech. Shuning uchun u poyezd, reys, yig'ilish, to'lov, topshiriq bilan juda tabiiy: The train left **on time**, pay the rent **on time**, finish the project **on time**. Kuchaytirish uchun: **right on time**, **exactly on time**, so'zlashuvda **bang on time**. Odam haqida: She's always **on time** — U doim aniq (punktual).

items.text: The match kicked off **on time**, despite the heavy rain.
items.translation: Kuchli yomg'irga qaramay, o'yin **belgilangan vaqtda** boshlandi.

items.text: Dilnoza always hands in her assignments **on time**.

blocks.text: **in time** jadvalga emas, **natijaga** qaraydi: biror narsa boshlanishidan yoki imkoniyat o'tib ketishidan **oldin** ulgurdingizmi? Ko'pincha **in time for** + ot (in time for the meeting) yoki **in time to** + fe'l (in time to catch the bus) shaklida keladi. Teskarisi — **too late** (kech bo'ldi). Poyezd kechikkan bo'lsa ham (not on time), siz uchrashuvga ulgurishingiz mumkin (in time) — shuning uchun ikki ibora bir gapda bemalol uchrashadi.

rows: Arrive **in good time** for your flight.
It's **too late** to change the date.

items.text: Tom got to the cinema **in time for** the start of the film.
The visa came **just in time** — two days before our flight.
items.translation: Viza **ayni vaqtida** keldi — reysimizdan ikki kun oldin.

items.text: Is it **too late** to apply for the summer course?

blocks.text: **in time** ning yana bir ma'nosi — «vaqt o'tishi bilan, asta-sekin»: **In time**, you'll get used to the noise of the city — Vaqt o'tib shahar shovqiniga ko'nikasiz. Bu ma'no **eventually** ga yaqin va ko'pincha gap boshida keladi.

**at the end of** + ot — biror narsa **tugayotgan paytda**, uning oxirgi qismida: **at the end of** the month, **at the end of** the film, **at the end of** the course. Bu — vaqt chizig'idagi **nuqta**, shuning uchun **at** (121-dars mantig'i). Kontekstdan aniq bo'lsa **of** siz ham: Questions will be answered **at the end**. Teskarisi — **at the beginning of** / **at the start of**. «in the end of» deyilmaydi: **of** kelsa — doim **at**. «... oxirigacha» (kechiktirmay) ma'nosi uchun esa **by the end of** ishlatiladi (→ 120-dars).

**in the end** — uzoq o'ylash, muammo, bahs yoki o'zgarishlardan **keyin** yakuniy natija: «oxir-oqibat», «pirovardida», «axiyri». Undan keyin **of** kelmaydi va u ko'pincha gap boshida yoki oxirida turadi: **In the end** we took a taxi. Teskarisi — **at first** (avvaliga). Yana bir yaqin ibora — **at last** (nihoyat): u uzoq **kutilgan** narsa nihoyat bo'lganida, yengillik bilan aytiladi: The rain has stopped **at last**! **in the end** esa kutishni emas, jarayon natijasini ta'kidlaydi.

rows: **In the end** we stayed at home.
**At first** I didn't like the job.

items.text: **At the end of** the meeting, the director thanked everyone for their work.
items.translation: Yig'ilish **oxirida** direktor hammaga mehnati uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

items.text: We argued for ages about where to go, but **in the end** we stayed at home.
items.translation: Qayerga borish haqida uzoq bahslashdik, lekin **oxir-oqibat** uyda qoldik.

items.text: The bus came **at last**, after forty minutes in the cold.
items.translation: Sovuqda qirq daqiqa kutganimizdan keyin **nihoyat** avtobus keldi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «in the end of the film» → **at the end of the film** (of bilan doim **at**); «oxir-oqibat» ma'nosida «At the end we decided to stay» → **In the end** we decided to stay; punktuallik haqida «Please be in time» → **Please be on time**; «I came on time to see the start» → **in time to see**; «at the last» → **at last**; «in last» → **in the end** yoki **at last**.

Rasm bilan eslang: **on** time — reja chizig'ining **ustida** turibsiz, undan bir qadam ham chetga chiqmadingiz. **in** time — hali kech bo'lmagan oraliqning **ichidasiz**. **at the end** — vaqt chizig'idagi oxirgi **nuqta**; **in the end** — butun jarayonning **ichidan** chiqqan natija.
Bog'lanish: at / on / in bilan vaqt — 121-dars; by the end of, by the time — 120-dars; at the end of the street, at the top (joy) — 124-dars; on holiday, on purpose kabi boshqa iboralar — 127-dars.

items: **on time** — reja bo'yicha, kechikmasdan (teskarisi — late): The flight landed **on time**.
**in time** (for / to) — ulgurib, kech qolmay (teskarisi — too late): We were **in time for** the film. **just in time** — arang ulgurib.
**at the end of** + ot — oxirgi qismida, of bilan doim at: **at the end of** the year.
**in the end** — oxir-oqibat, uzoq jarayondan keyin: **In the end** she accepted the offer.
**at first** — avvaliga; **at last** — nihoyat (uzoq kutishdan keyin).

examples.title: **on time**: as planned, not late
examples.description: on time — jadval yoki rejada belgilangan vaqtda, kechikmasdan. Teskarisi — late; kuchaytirilgani — right on time.

sentences.text: Surprisingly, the Afrosiyob train to Samarkand left exactly **on time** despite the snow.
sentences.translation: Ajablanarlisi, Samarqandga ketadigan «Afrosiyob» poyezdi qorga qaramay roppa-rosa **o'z vaqtida** jo'nadi.

sentences.text: Make sure you're **on time** for the interview — the manager hates waiting.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga **kechikmay** kelishga harakat qiling — menejer kutishni yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: Bekzod has never paid his rent **on time**, so the landlord doesn't trust him.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ijara haqini hech qachon **o'z vaqtida** to'lamagan, shuning uchun uy egasi unga ishonmaydi.

sentences.text: Did the webinar start **on time**, or did you have to wait?
sentences.translation: Vebinar **belgilangan vaqtda** boshlandimi yoki kutishingizga to'g'ri keldimi?

sentences.text: Thanks to careful planning, the new school opened **on time** and within budget.
sentences.translation: Puxta rejalashtirish tufayli yangi maktab **muddatida** va byudjet doirasida ochildi.

sentences.text: Our flight from London was two hours late, but the return flight was **right on time**.
sentences.translation: Londondan reysimiz ikki soat kechikdi, lekin qaytish reysi **roppa-rosa vaqtida** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Sarah is never **on time** for anything, so we always tell her to come half an hour earlier.
sentences.translation: Sara hech qachon hech narsaga **vaqtida** kelmaydi, shuning uchun unga doim yarim soat oldinroq kelishni aytamiz.

sentences.text: If the work isn't finished **on time**, the company will have to pay a fine.
sentences.translation: Agar ish **muddatida** tugatilmasa, kompaniya jarima to'lashga majbur bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Japanese trains are famous for running **on time** — even a one-minute delay is news.
sentences.translation: Yapon poyezdlari **o'z vaqtida** qatnashi bilan mashhur — hatto bir daqiqalik kechikish ham yangilik bo'ladi.

sentences.text: How can you deliver the parcels **on time** when the roads are blocked with snow?
sentences.translation: Yo'llar qor bilan to'silgan bo'lsa, posilkalarni qanday qilib **o'z vaqtida** yetkazasiz?

examples.title: **in time for** the meeting, **in time to** catch the bus
examples.description: in time — kech qolmasdan, biror narsaga ulgurib: in time for + ot, in time to + fe'l. Teskarisi — too late.

sentences.text: Do you think you'll finish work **in time for** our dinner reservation at eight?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, ishni soat sakkizdagi **kechki ovqat broniga ulgurib** tugatasizmi?

sentences.text: Hurry up, or we won't get to the stadium **in time to see** the kick-off.
sentences.translation: Tezroq bo'l, aks holda stadionga o'yin boshlanishini **ko'rishga ulgurmaymiz**.

sentences.text: The ambulance arrived **in time**, and the doctors saved the old man's life.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam **kech qolmay** yetib keldi va shifokorlar qariyaning hayotini saqlab qolishdi.

sentences.text: I'm afraid the new laptops won't be delivered **in time for** the training course.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, yangi noutbuklar o'quv **kursiga ulgurib** yetkazilmaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza recovered from the flu **in time for** her sister's wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza singlisining **to'yiga ulgurib** grippdan tuzalib oldi.

sentences.text: If we take a taxi, we'll be at the station **in time to catch** the last train.
sentences.translation: Taksiga o'tirsak, bekatga oxirgi **poyezdga ulgurib** yetib boramiz.

sentences.text: Will the bridge be repaired **in time for** the tourist season?
sentences.translation: Ko'prik turistik **mavsumga ulgurib** ta'mirlanadimi?

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the fire brigade didn't get there **in time to save** the old barn.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, o't o'chiruvchilar eski omborxonani **saqlab qolishga ulgurmadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur ran all the way from the metro and got to the exam **in time**.
sentences.translation: Jasur metrodan to'xtamay yugurdi va imtihonga **kech qolmay** yetib keldi.

sentences.text: I wanted tickets for the concert, but when I finally tried, it was **too late**.
sentences.translation: Konsertga chipta olmoqchi edim, lekin nihoyat urinib ko'rganimda **kech bo'lgan edi**.

examples.title: **just in time**, **in good time**, **too late**
examples.description: just in time — oxirgi lahzada, arang ulgurib; in plenty of time / in good time — vaqt bemalol qolib, barvaqt; too late — kech qolib.

sentences.text: Jasur jumped into the lift **just in time** — the doors closed a second later.
sentences.translation: Jasur liftga **arang ulgurib** kirdi — eshiklar bir soniyadan keyin yopildi.

sentences.text: Get to the airport **in plenty of time**, because the security queues can be very long.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **vaqtni bemalol qoldirib** boring, chunki xavfsizlik navbatlari juda uzun bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Kate remembered her mother's birthday **just in time** and ordered flowers online.
sentences.translation: Keyt onasining tug'ilgan kunini **oxirgi lahzada** esladi va onlayn gul buyurtma qildi.

sentences.text: When Aziz finally applied for the job, it was **too late** — they'd already chosen someone.
sentences.translation: Aziz nihoyat ishga ariza topshirganda, **kech bo'lgan edi** — ular allaqachon boshqa odamni tanlab bo'lishgandi.

sentences.text: Please send your passport details **in good time**, so that we can book the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani band qila olishimiz uchun pasport ma'lumotlaringizni **oldinroq** yuboring.

sentences.text: The surgeon said that Oliver had come to hospital **just in time**.
sentences.translation: Jarrohning aytishicha, Oliver kasalxonaga **ayni o'z vaqtida** kelgan ekan.

sentences.text: Is it **too late** to change my seat, or can I still do it online?
sentences.translation: O'rindig'imni o'zgartirishga **kech bo'lmadimi** yoki hali ham onlayn qilsa bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: We arrived at the theatre **in plenty of time**, so we had a coffee in the foyer.
sentences.translation: Teatrga **ancha barvaqt** keldik, shuning uchun foyeda qahva ichdik.

sentences.text: Luckily, the mechanic found the problem **just in time**, before we set off across the desert.
sentences.translation: Baxtimizga, usta muammoni sahro bo'ylab yo'lga chiqishimizdan oldin **ayni vaqtida** topdi.

sentences.text: Don't leave everything until the last minute — start revising **in good time**.
sentences.translation: Hammasini oxirgi daqiqaga qoldirma — takrorlashni **oldindan** boshla.

examples.title: **on time** or **in time**? Both in one sentence
examples.description: on time — jadval bo'yicha, in time — biror narsaga ulgurish. Poyezd kechiksa ham, biz ulgurishimiz mumkin — shuning uchun ikkalasi bir gapda keladi.

sentences.text: The bus wasn't **on time**, but we were still **in time for** the film.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **o'z vaqtida** kelmadi, lekin biz baribir kinoga **ulgurdik**.

sentences.text: If the plane takes off **on time**, I'll be in Oxford **in time for** the lecture.
sentences.translation: Agar samolyot **o'z vaqtida** uchsa, Oksforddagi ma'ruzaga **ulguraman**.

sentences.text: The meeting started **on time**, but Tom didn't arrive **in time to hear** the introduction.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **vaqtida** boshlandi, lekin Tom kirish so'zini **eshitishga ulgurmadi**.

sentences.text: I left home late, but the train was delayed, so I got to the station **in time**.
sentences.translation: Uydan kech chiqdim, lekin poyezd kechikdi, shuning uchun bekatga **ulgurib** keldim.

sentences.text: Always submit your tax return **on time** — otherwise you'll pay a penalty.
sentences.translation: Soliq deklaratsiyasini doim **muddatida** topshiring — aks holda jarima to'laysiz.

sentences.text: The builders didn't finish the hotel **on time**, but it opened **in time for** the summer.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar mehmonxonani **belgilangan muddatda** tugatmadi, lekin u yozgi **mavsumga ulgurib** ochildi.

sentences.text: Are you sure we'll be **in time**? The concert starts in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: **Ulgurishimizga** ishonchingiz komilmi? Konsert yigirma daqiqadan keyin boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Nilufar is always **on time** for work, even when the metro is crowded.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ishga doim **vaqtida** keladi, hatto metro gavjum bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: Emma's flight landed **on time**, so she was **in time for** her brother's graduation.
sentences.translation: Emmaning reysi **o'z vaqtida** qo'ndi, shuning uchun u ukasining bitiruv marosimiga **ulgurdi**.

sentences.text: Which matters more for a courier — being **on time** or being polite?
sentences.translation: Kuryer uchun nima muhimroq — **o'z vaqtida** yetkazishmi yoki xushmuomalalikmi?

examples.title: **at the end of** the month, the film, the course
examples.description: at the end (of) — biror narsaning oxirgi qismida, tugash paytida. Teskarisi — at the beginning (of). «in the end of» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Everybody stood up and clapped **at the end of** the performance.
sentences.translation: Spektakl **oxirida** hamma o'rnidan turib qarsak chaldi.

sentences.text: I get paid **at the end of** every month, so money is always tight around the 25th.
sentences.translation: Maoshni har oyning **oxirida** olaman, shuning uchun 25-sana atrofida pulim doim tanqis bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **At the end of** the course, each student has to give a short presentation in English.
sentences.translation: Kurs **oxirida** har bir talaba ingliz tilida qisqa taqdimot qilishi kerak.

sentences.text: Questions will be answered **at the end**, so please keep them until then.
sentences.translation: Savollarga **oxirida** javob beriladi, shuning uchun ularni o'shangacha saqlab turing.

sentences.text: Madina is moving to London **at the end of** August to start her master's.
sentences.translation: Madina magistraturani boshlash uchun avgust **oxirida** Londonga ko'chib ketyapti.

sentences.text: Did you understand what happened **at the end of** the film? I was completely lost.
sentences.translation: Film **oxirida** nima bo'lganini tushundingmi? Men butunlay chalkashib ketdim.

sentences.text: **At the beginning of** the year, the company hired twenty new programmers.
sentences.translation: Yil **boshida** kompaniya yigirmata yangi dasturchini ishga oldi.

sentences.text: Prices are usually lower **at the end of** the season, when shops need space for new stock.
sentences.translation: Narxlar odatda mavsum **oxirida**, do'konlarga yangi tovar uchun joy kerak bo'lganda, pastroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Remind me to give you the keys **at the end of** the lesson.
sentences.translation: Dars **oxirida** senga kalitlarni berishni eslatib qo'y.

sentences.text: James felt exhausted but happy **at the end of** his first week as a teacher.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'qituvchi sifatidagi birinchi haftasining **oxirida** charchagan, lekin baxtiyor edi.

examples.title: **In the end**: finally, after problems or changes
examples.description: in the end — oxir-oqibat: uzoq o'ylash, muammo yoki o'zgarishlardan keyingi yakuniy natija. Undan keyin of kelmaydi.

sentences.text: We looked at fifteen flats, and **in the end** we rented the very first one.
sentences.translation: O'n beshta kvartirani ko'rdik va **oxir-oqibat** eng birinchisini ijaraga oldik.

sentences.text: The hotel lost our booking, but **in the end** they gave us a better room for free.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona bronimizni yo'qotib qo'ydi, lekin **oxir-oqibat** bizga bepul yaxshiroq xona berishdi.

sentences.text: **In the end**, the match was cancelled because of the heavy snow.
sentences.translation: **Oxir-oqibat** kuchli qor tufayli o'yin bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: Don't worry too much — everything will be fine **in the end**.
sentences.translation: Ko'p xavotir olma — **oxiri** hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The negotiations lasted for months, but **in the end** both sides signed the agreement.
sentences.translation: Muzokaralar oylab davom etdi, lekin **pirovardida** ikki tomon ham kelishuvni imzoladi.

sentences.text: How did you get home **in the end**? Did you manage to find a taxi?
sentences.translation: **Oxiri** uyga qanday yetib olding? Taksi topa oldingmi?

sentences.text: Sarah wanted to study abroad, but **in the end** she stayed in Manchester to be near her family.
sentences.translation: Sara chet elda o'qimoqchi edi, lekin **oxir-oqibat** oilasiga yaqin bo'lish uchun Manchesterda qoldi.

sentences.text: At first the new software seemed complicated, but **in the end** everybody got used to it.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga yangi dastur murakkab tuyuldi, lekin **oxir-oqibat** hamma unga ko'nikib ketdi.

sentences.text: Nobody believed the small start-up would survive, but **in the end** it became a market leader.
sentences.translation: Kichik startap omon qoladi deb hech kim ishonmagandi, lekin **pirovardida** u bozor yetakchisiga aylandi.

sentences.text: It took Dilnoza three attempts, but **in the end** she passed her driving test.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga uchta urinish kerak bo'ldi, lekin **axiyri** u haydovchilik imtihonidan o'tdi.

examples.title: **at the end** or **in the end**? **at first**, **at last**
examples.description: Juft taqqoslash: at the end (of) — oxirgi qismida, in the end — oxir-oqibat; at first — avvaliga, at last — nihoyat (uzoq kutishdan keyin), at the beginning (of) — boshida.

sentences.text: **At the end of** the interview they offered me the job, so I didn't have to wait.
sentences.translation: Suhbat **oxirida** menga ishni taklif qilishdi, shuning uchun kutib o'tirishimga to'g'ri kelmadi.

sentences.text: The interview was really difficult, but **in the end** I got the job.
sentences.translation: Suhbat juda qiyin bo'ldi, lekin **oxir-oqibat** ishga qabul qilindim.

sentences.text: **At first** I hated living in a big city, but now I can't imagine living anywhere else.
sentences.translation: **Avvaliga** katta shaharda yashashni yomon ko'rardim, endi esa boshqa joyda yashashni tasavvur ham qila olmayman.

sentences.text: Look, the rain has stopped **at last** — let's go for a walk!
sentences.translation: Qara, **nihoyat** yomg'ir to'xtadi — sayrga chiqaylik!

sentences.text: **At last**! I've been waiting for this parcel for three weeks.
sentences.translation: **Nihoyat**! Bu posilkani uch haftadan beri kutayotgandim.

sentences.text: We argued about the name for weeks, and **in the end** we called the baby Amir.
sentences.translation: Ism haqida haftalab bahslashdik va **oxir-oqibat** chaqaloqqa Amir deb ism qo'ydik.

sentences.text: There's a short test **at the end of** each unit to check your progress.
sentences.translation: Har bir bo'lim **oxirida** bilimingizni tekshirish uchun qisqa test bor.

sentences.text: Bekzod was nervous **at the beginning of** his speech, but he relaxed after a few minutes.
sentences.translation: Bekzod nutqining **boshida** hayajonlandi, lekin bir necha daqiqadan keyin o'zini bosib oldi.

sentences.text: Tom tried to fix the printer himself, but **in the end** he had to call a technician.
sentences.translation: Tom printerni o'zi tuzatmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin **oxir-oqibat** ustani chaqirishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: After two years of building work, the new metro line has **at last** opened.
sentences.translation: Ikki yillik qurilish ishlaridan so'ng yangi metro liniyasi **nihoyat** ochildi.

examples.title: Dialogue: did you make it in time?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st aeroport va bitiruv marosimi haqida gaplashadi — on time, in time, at the end, in the end, at first bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hi Kate! Did you get to the airport **in time** yesterday?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Keyt! Kecha aeroportga **ulgurdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Only **just in time**! The taxi came late, and then we got stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: — **Arang ulgurdim**! Taksi kech keldi, keyin tirbandlikka tiqilib qoldik.

sentences.text: — Oh no! Did the plane at least leave **on time**?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Hech bo'lmasa samolyot **o'z vaqtida** uchdimi?

sentences.text: — No, there was a delay, so **in the end** I sat at the gate for an hour.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, kechikish bo'ldi, shuning uchun **oxir-oqibat** chiqish eshigi oldida bir soat o'tirdim.

sentences.text: — Typical! And were you **in time for** your sister's graduation in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: — Doim shunday! Edinburgdagi singlingning bitiruviga **ulgurdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I arrived **at the end of** the speeches, just before they gave out the diplomas.
sentences.translation: — Ha, nutqlarning **oxirida**, diplomlar topshirilishidan biroz oldin yetib keldim.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! Was she nervous **at the beginning** of the ceremony?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! U marosim **boshida** hayajonlandimi?

sentences.text: — Very nervous **at first**, but she relaxed when she saw me in the hall.
sentences.translation: — **Avvaliga** juda hayajonlandi, lekin zalda meni ko'rib, o'zini bosib oldi.

sentences.text: — That's lovely. Next time, leave home **in plenty of time**, OK?
sentences.translation: — Juda yoqimli. Keyingi safar uydan **ertaroq** chiq, xo'pmi?

sentences.text: — I will! I've learnt my lesson — from now on I want to be **on time** for everything.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! Saboq oldim — bundan buyon hamma narsaga **vaqtida** yetib borishni xohlayman.
